_comment: Battle AI phase 2 subcommander flank coverage demo. Team 1 deploys a 3-unit defensive group under defensive doctrine (PLAN_DEFEND): two flank infantry blocks holding the front line and a supporting center block echeloned behind. Team 0 holds opposite with frontal and flank infantry. When the player orders the left flanking infantry (uid 1) forward, it crosses inside FLANK_ENEMY_RANGE (260 wu) at x = 260 while remaining outside detection range (190 wu) and melee contact. Subcommander._flank_is_outflanked returns true, triggering _cover_one_flank: the center infantry (uid 4, the nearest available ally) are dispatched to extend the line outward to cover the threatened left flank at (400, 720). The clip runs to tick 1020 while the reserve closes on the cover point; arrival timing varies slightly between platforms, so the pinned expectations cover the dispatch, not the settle.
